name: team_planning_rebase_plan
description: Update a Team Planning plan to today (a UTC day): its base moves to today and every scenario reads the Org Graph as of it, with nothing else rewritten. A first step after the baseline that starts before the new base starts on it; one that starts later keeps its start. Read team_planning_rebase_preview first and pass the base_on it gave, so an update made since is refused rather than taken in unseen. A change that conflicts with the Org Graph at that moment stays conflicting in team_planning_status while the scenario still resolves to that change: a set, pin, clear or undo ends it. Undo does not reverse an update: a base only moves forward. Refused when the plan already stands on today or a day still to come, when the first step would end before today, naming it, and, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is an editor.

base_on.description: The base the preview read, YYYY-MM-DD.
